description: Golden incident scenarios scored against the simulation world model (tools/simulation.ts). Deterministic without an LLM key (planner/synthesizer fallbacks); with a key, scores measure real planner+synthesizer quality against the same ground truth. Scoring text = summary + probable_cause of the final report.

scenarios.goal: payments-service p99 latency at 4s after deploy
scenarios.why: Classic true-positive: the world model has a real latency regression here.

scenarios.goal: orders-service transactions failing with lock errors
scenarios.why: True-positive for the deadlock failure mode.

scenarios.goal: inventory-service pods restarting and memory climbing
scenarios.why: True-positive for the OOM failure mode.
Anti-circularity: the alert claims deadlock but the world model has a latency regression. The report must describe what the data shows, not what the alert claimed.

scenarios.goal: auth-service 401 errors spiking after deploy v2.3
scenarios.why: False alarm: auth-service is healthy in the world model. The honest outcome is 'no clear anomaly', not a fabricated cause.
Second false alarm on a healthy service.
Service outside the known world: the pipeline must not invent findings about a system it has no data for.
